arxiv-2009-06698.title: Not the garden hose instability: wavelength selection in a buckling garden hose
arxiv-2009-06698.creator: Tianyi Guo, Xiaoyu Zheng, Peter Palffy-Muhoray
arxiv-2009-06698.description: Abstract We consider sinusoidal undulations which appear on certain garden hoses under normal use. We propose a model, using linear elasticity, explaining this phenomenon, and make a connection with biological structures as well as self-buckling. We compare observations with model predictions, and suggest potential applications in the area of shape-changing materials.

arxiv-2201-00971.title: SubMix: Practical Private Prediction for Large-scale Language Models
arxiv-2201-00971.creator: Antonio A. Ginart, Laurens van der Maaten, James Zou, Chuan Guo
arxiv-2201-00971.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Antonio A. Ginart, Laurens van der Maaten, James Zou, Chuan Guo. Recent data-extraction attacks have exposed that language models can memorize some training samples verbatim. This is a vulnerability that can compromise the privacy of the model’s training data. In this work, we introduce SubMix : a practical protocol for private next-token prediction designed to prevent privacy violations by language models that were fine-tuned on a private corpus after pre-training on a public corpus.

arxiv-2211-07645.title: Evaluating Distribution System Reliability with Hyperstructures Graph Convolutional Nets
arxiv-2211-07645.creator: Yuzhou Chen, Tian Jiang, Miguel Heleno, Alexandre Moreira, Yulia R. Gel
arxiv-2211-07645.description: Abstract Nowadays, it is broadly recognized in the power system community that to meet the ever expanding energy sector’s needs, it is no longer possible to rely solely on physics-based models and that reliable, timely and sustainable operation of energy systems is impossible without systematic integration of artificial intelligence (AI) tools.

arxiv-2305-14939.title: Improved Complexity Analysis of the Sinkhorn and Greenkhorn Algorithms for Optimal Transport 0 0 footnotetext: JL and DY contribute equally.

arxiv-2305-14939.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Jianzhou Luo, Dingchuan Yang, Ke Wei. The Sinkhorn algorithm is a widely used method for solving the optimal transport problem, and the Greenkhorn algorithm is one of its variants. arxiv-2308-08816.title: End-to-end Alternating Optimization for Real-World Blind Super Resolution
arxiv-2308-08816.creator: Zhengxiong Luo, Yan Huang, Shang Li, Liang Wang, Tieniu Tan
arxiv-2308-08816.description: Abstract Blind Super-Resolution (SR) usually involves two sub-problems: 1) estimating the degradation of the given low-resolution (LR) image; 2) super-resolving the LR image to its high-resolution (HR) counterpart. Both problems are ill-posed due to the information loss in the degrading process.

arxiv-2401-14789.title: Study of spin polarization dependence on rapidity, transverse momentum, and azimuthal angle
arxiv-2401-14789.description: Abstract We investigate the spacetime evolution of spin polarization within a hydrodynamic framework based on the de Groot–van Leeuwen–van Weert expressions for energy-momentum and spin tensors. The system’s deviation from boost invariance results in the interplay of different spin polarization components, impacting spin observables.

arxiv-2404-06031.title: FuSeBMC AI: Acceleration of Hybrid Approach through Machine Learning
arxiv-2404-06031.creator: Kaled M. Alshmrany (🖂), Mohannad Aldughaim, Chenfeng Wei, Tom Sweet, Richard Allmendinger, Lucas C. Cordeiro
arxiv-2404-06031.description: Abstract We present FuSeBMC -AI, a test generation tool grounded in machine learning techniques. FuSeBMC -AI extracts various features from the program and employs support vector machine and neural network models to predict a hybrid approach’s optimal configuration. FuSeBMC -AI utilizes Bounded Model Checking and Fuzzing as back-end verification engines.

arxiv-2405-09695.title: Enhancing Saliency Prediction in Monitoring Tasks: The Role of Visual Highlights Conference: ETRA ’24; June 04–07, 2024; Glasgow, UK CCS: Human-centered computing
arxiv-2405-09695.creator: Zekun Wu, Anna Maria Feit
arxiv-2405-09695.description: Abstract . This study examines the role of visual highlights in guiding user attention in drone monitoring tasks, employing a simulated interface for observation. The experiment results show that such highlights can significantly expedite the visual attention on the corresponding area.

arxiv-2410-06638.title: Subtle Errors in Reasoning: Preference Learning via Error-injected Self-editing
arxiv-2410-06638.creator: Kaishuai Xu, Tiezheng Yu, Wenjun Hou, Yi Cheng, Chak Tou Leong, Liangyou Li, Xin Jiang, Lifeng Shang, Qun Liu, Wenjie Li
arxiv-2410-06638.description: Abstract Large Language Models (LLMs) have exhibited strong mathematical reasoning prowess, tackling tasks ranging from basic arithmetic to advanced competition-level problems. However, frequently occurring subtle yet critical errors, such as miscalculations or incorrect substitutions, limit the LLMs’ full potential. Existing studies to improve mathematical ability typically involve applying preference learning to step-wise solution pairs.

arxiv-2412-11809.title: Parallel CPU- and GPU-based connected component algorithms for event building for hybrid pixel detectors
arxiv-2412-11809.creator: and P. Mánek
arxiv-2412-11809.description: Abstract The latest generation of Timepix series hybrid pixel detectors enhance particle tracking with high spatial and temporal resolution. However, their high hit-rate capability poses challenges for data processing, particularly in multidetector configurations or systems like Timepix4. Storing and processing each hit offline is inefficient for such high data throughput.

arxiv-2412-20452.title: S 1 S^{1} reduction of 4D 𝒩 = 4 \mathcal{N}{=}\,4 Schur index and 3D 𝒩 = 8 \mathcal{N}{=}\,8 mass-deformed partition function
arxiv-2412-20452.creator: Tomoki Nakanishi, Takahiro Nishinaka
arxiv-2412-20452.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Tomoki Nakanishi, Takahiro Nishinaka. We study the compactification of 4D 𝒩 = 4 \mathcal{N}{=}\,4 SYM on S 1 S^{1} from the viewpoint of the superconformal index. In the cases that the gauge group of the 4D SYM is U ⁡ ( N ) U(N) and U ​ s ​ p ​ ( 2 ​ N ) Usp(2N) , the resulting 3D theory is believed to be the ABJM theory with the Chern-Simons level k = 1 k=1 and k = 2 k=2 , respectively.

arxiv-2502-04045.title: Comparing privacy notions for protection against reconstruction attacks in machine learning
arxiv-2502-04045.creator: Sayan Biswas, Mark Dras, Pedro Faustini, Natasha Fernandes, Annabelle McIver, Catuscia Palamidessi, Parastoo Sadeghi
arxiv-2502-04045.description: Abstract Within the machine learning community, reconstruction attacks are a principal concern and have been identified even in federated learning (FL), which was designed with privacy preservation in mind. In response to these threats, the privacy community recommends the use of differential privacy (DP) in the stochastic gradient descent algorithm, termed DP-SGD.

plaw-109-28-2005.description: Public Law 109-28 (2005): An act to designate the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 120 East Illinois Avenue in Vinita, Oklahoma, as the "Francis C. Goodpaster Post Office Building".

pmc-10569901.title: Delayed esophageal anastomotic complication and ramucirumab therapy: A case report
pmc-10569901.creator: Robert H Roth, Madison J Malfitano, Matthew Reilley, Linda W Martin
pmc-10569901.description: Current NCCN guidelines for second‐line therapy in recurrent or metastatic esophago‐gastric cancers recommend the use of VEGF inhibitors such as ramucirumab. VEGF inhibitors have been shown to be associated with gastrointestinal perforation in clinical trials and late colorectal anastomotic leaks in a few case reports. Here, we present a case of late esophageal anastomotic leak in a patient receiving ramucirumab.

pmc-10617909.title: The prevalence and pattern of complementary and alternative medicine use among cancer patients in a tertiary oncology center: a cross-sectional study
pmc-10617909.creator: Nabil Abdullah Almouaalamy, Lama A Banjar, Haifa M Alshaikh, Jood M Altowairqi, Nuha M Alharbi, Waad A Alghamdi
pmc-10617909.description: Background:Complementary and alternative medicine (CAM) is widely used nationally and internationally for multiple medical conditions, including different stages of cancer. It is used by the patients for multiple purposes, including to cure diseases or resolve symptoms, as patients have the misconception that natural remedies are safer than radiotherapy and chemotherapy.

pmc-11470747.title: Gaussian quadrature method with exponential fitting factor for two-parameter singularly perturbed parabolic problem
pmc-11470747.creator: Shegaye Lema Cheru, Gemechis File Duressa, Tariku Birabasa Mekonnen
pmc-11470747.description: The parabolic convection-diffusion-reaction problem is examined in this work, where the diffusion and convection terms are multiplied by two small parameters, respectively. The proposed approach is based on a fitted operator finite difference method. The Crank-Nicolson method on uniform mesh is utilized to discretize the time variables in the first step.

pmc-12469922.title: Identifying Network Propagation Sources Using Advanced Centrality Measures
pmc-12469922.creator: Damian Frąszczak, José FF Mendes, Zi-Ke Zhang
pmc-12469922.description: We live in a time dominated by interconnected networks surrounding us on all fronts. The emergence of social media platforms has driven the expansion of social networks, facilitating fast communication worldwide. Responses to content shared on these platforms can be seen as a propagation process, where information spreads through social networks.

pmc-12472441.title: Impact of Thermal Processing and Carbohydrate Carriers on Amino Acids, Sugars, Phenolic Compounds, and Maillard Reaction Markers Relevant to Nutritional Quality and Safety of Rosa canina L. Juice Powders
pmc-12472441.creator: Anna Michalska-Ciechanowska, Jessica Brzezowska, Maria Dolores del Castillo, Marta Beatriz López-Parra, Lidia Montero, Nancy Nicolet, Igor P Turkiewicz, Wilfried Andlauer, Juan M Benito, Trinidad Velasco-Torrijos
pmc-12472441.description: Rosa canina L. powders are rich in bioactive compounds; however, thermal processing and carrier addition can markedly alter their composition, affecting nutritional quality, safety and potential health effects. This study assessed the impact of juice pasteurization, followed by freeze-drying and spray drying with maltodextrin, inulin, trehalose, or palatinose, on amino acids, sugars, phenolic compounds, and Maillard reaction products.

pmc-12557605.title: Feasibility of Portable Laser Doppler Flowmeter for Foot Blood Flow Assessment in Patients With Chronic Limb Threatening Ischaemia
pmc-12557605.creator: Masahiro Tezuka, Shotaro Hirota, Masashi Kawamura, Taisuke Konishi, Ikuko Shibasaki, Hirotsugu Fukuda
pmc-12557605.description: ObjectiveThe portable, non-invasive laser Doppler flowmeter (LDF) provides a practical alternative, enabling bedside blood flow assessment for chronic limb threatening ischaemia (CLTI). The present study aimed to evaluate whether LDF could identify CLTI and to assess the utility of LDF in determining the efficacy of revascularisation.

pmc-12564078.title: Optimization of Exergy Output Rate in a Supercritical CO2 Brayton Cogeneration System
pmc-12564078.creator: Jiachi Shan, Shaojun Xia, Qinglong Jin, Adriano Viana Ensinas
pmc-12564078.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). To address low energy utilization efficiency and severe exergy destruction from direct discharge of high-temperature turbine exhaust, this study proposes a supercritical CO2 Brayton cogeneration system with a series-connected hot water heat exchanger for stepwise waste heat recovery. Based on finite-time thermodynamics, a physical model that provides a more realistic framework by incorporating finite temperature difference heat transfer, irreversible compression, and expansion losses is established.

pmc-12649180.title: Bird Diversity and Bird-Strike Risk at Lincang Boshang Airport
pmc-12649180.creator: Jun Liu, Peng Liu, Jia Li, Jiansong Zhang, Yubao Duan
pmc-12649180.description: Simple SummaryBird collisions with aircraft threaten flight safety, yet airports can also support many bird species. We surveyed birds at Lincang Boshang Airport in Yunnan, China, and nearby habitats across four seasons. We recorded 148 species and examined how different habitats—wetlands, forests, farmland, and urban areas—shape bird communities.

pmc-13017085.title: Amebic liver abscess with bronchopleural fistula
pmc-13017085.creator: Michaela Schumacher, Andrea Erba, Seraina Bally, Seraina Frei, Maja Weisser Rohacek, Andreas Neumayr, Anne-Valérie Burgener-Gasser
pmc-13017085.description: HighlightAmebic liver abscess with bronchopleural fistula caused by Entamoeba histolytica can mimic severe bacterial sepsis in a returning traveller. Rapid diagnosis via multiplex Polymerase Chain Reaction (PCR) on abscess fluid enabled targeted therapy within 24 h, avoiding unnecessary broad-spectrum antibiotics. Intestinal amebiasis should be considered in patients with compatible symptoms and relevant exposure.

pmc-13028186.title: Assessment of Visual Acuity and Stereopsis in Older Adults: A Comparison Between a Screening Application and Clinical Standards—A Feasibility Study
pmc-13028186.creator: Dorottya Wiegand, Eszter Mikó-Baráth, Ildikó Telkes, Balázs Patczai, Adrienne Csutak, Vanda Agnes Nemes
pmc-13028186.description: Background and Objectives: Visual impairment and reduced stereovision significantly impact the quality of life and increase fall risk in older adults. While standard clinical assessment of visual functions is essential in this population, its use is often limited by the need for specialized equipment and trained personnel. Tablet-based screening tools offer a practical alternative but require clinical validation.

pmc-13123287.title: Reproductive Health Services in Abortion-Providing Clinics: A Scoping Review of Provision and Policy Contexts
pmc-13123287.creator: Katherine M Mahoney, Licia Bravo, Arden McAllister, Kacie Bogar, Sean Hennessy, Courtney A Schreiber, Alice Abernathy
pmc-13123287.description: Objectives:Abortion-providing clinics often offer preventive reproductive health services. We conducted a scoping review to characterize provision of contraceptive care, sexually transmitted infection (STI) testing and/or treatment, and cervical cancer prevention and/or screening at U.S. abortion-providing clinics and to highlight policy drivers of variation in access to and provision of these services at the time of abortion by abortion-providing clinics.

pmc-13141636.title: Single-cell transcriptomics reveals pediatric immune responses to COVID-19 vaccination
pmc-13141636.creator: Xiong Zhu, Jie Wang, Xiaoxia Wang, Zhaomin Feng, Linglong Wan, Lin Sun, Jin Fu, Fei Xiao, Xiaolan Huang, Nan Jia, Min Chen, Juan Zhou, Yi Wang, Quanyi Wang
pmc-13141636.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). SummaryInactivated vaccines are critical to COVID-19 immunization, yet the cellular and molecular mechanisms driving pediatric responses warrant detailed characterization. We use single-cell transcriptomics to delineate the immune landscape of peripheral blood mononuclear cells in children vaccinated with CoronaVac. We uncovered a two-phase program: the primary dose establishes a memory foundation via expansion of survival-programmed memory B cells and a shift in CD8+ T cells toward stress adaptation.

pmc-13418196.title: Crystal-Field Properties of Pentalene Ligands in Erbium(III) Sandwich Complexes
pmc-13418196.creator: Siddhartha De, Arpan Mondal, F. Geoffrey N. Cloke, Jinkui Tang, Richard A. Layfield
pmc-13418196.description: The influence of pentalene ligands on the crystal-field properties of erbium­(III) has been examined using the monometallic complexes [Er­(η8-Pn†)2]− (1) and [(η8-Pn†)­Er­(η8-COT)]− (2) (Pn† = [1,4-( i Pr3Si)2C8H4]2–, COT = [C8H8]2–), which were synthesized as [K­(2.2.2-crypt)]+ salts. Both compounds display magnetic anisotropy consistent with the prolate ion Er3+, but do not exhibit slow magnetic relaxation in zero field.

pmc-13612545.title: Editorial: Understanding IGF-I's impact on neurocognitive aging: insights and therapeutic directions
pmc-13612545.creator: Jonathan Adrián Zegarra-Valdivia, Ignacio Torres-Aleman, Angel Nuñez
pmc-13612545.description: derstood solely based on its circulating or tissue concentrations. Rather, current evidence supports a context-dependent model in which IGF-I acts as an integrative signal coordinating cellular maintenance, synaptic and circuit function, metabolism, sleep–wake regulation, mood, and cognition (Nuñez et al., 2023; García-Magro et al., 2025; Zegarra-Valdivia et al., 2025a).

uslaw-usc-t15-s205.title: 15 U.S.C. § 205 — Metric system defined
uslaw-usc-t15-s205.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t15-s205.description: United States Code, Title 15 (Commerce And Trade); Chapter 6 (Weights And Measures And Standard Time); Subchapter I (Weights, Measures, And Standards Generally). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. The metric system of measurement shall be defined as the International System of Units as established in 1960, and subsequently maintained, by the General Conference of Weights and Measures, and as interpreted or modified.
